# PANaCEa
> Adaptive clinical education platform. React 19 + Hono + Prisma + Cloudflare Edge.
> 9,648 tests, 517 files, 560 Edge functions, 190 Prisma models, 595 components.

## Quick Start
- Repo: `/Users/aaronullger/GitHub/StudyPANaCEa`
- Install: `npm ci`
- Dev: `npm run dev:wrangler`
- Test: `npm test` (9,648 tests, ~75s)
- Build: `npm run build` (~15s inc, ~38s full)
- Typecheck: `NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" npm run typecheck`

## Architecture
- Frontend: `components/`, `hooks/`, `lib/`, `pages/`, `config/`
- Backend: `functions/api/` (Cloudflare Edge, 560 endpoints)
- Database: `prisma/schema.prisma` (190 models, 5,181 lines)
- Auth: Clerk (RBAC via UserRole)
- AI: Gemini (server-side only)
- Testing: Vitest + Playwright

## Key Files
- Entry: `index.html` → `index.tsx` → `App.tsx`
- Routing: `config/AppRoutes.tsx`, `config/routes.ts`, `config/lazyComponents.tsx`
- Session: `components/session/CoreAdaptiveSession.tsx`
- FSRS: `lib/fsrs.ts`, `lib/implicit-metrics.ts`, `lib/services/drillReviewService.ts`
- Edge API: `functions/api/_shared/middleware.ts`, `functions/api/_shared/auth.ts`
- Content: `functions/api/content/`, `functions/api/questions/generate*.ts`
- Sync: `lib/services/sync/syncManager.ts`, `lib/services/offlineSyncService.ts`

## Docs
- Architecture: `docs/ARCHITECTURE_README.md`
- Database: `docs/database/normalized-study-schema.md`
- API: `docs/api/API_OVERVIEW.md`
- Agents: `docs/skills-overview.md` (44 skills)
- Deployment: `docs/deployment/`
- Recovery plan: `APP_FUNCTIONALITY_PLAN.md`
- Implementation: `NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`

## Agent Ecosystem
- Coordinator: `panacea-syncytium-coordinator`
- Coordination: `docs/autoclaw/coordination/` (mission, file_claims, handoffs, risk_register, verification)
- 20 PANaCEa-specific + 24 reusable skills in `.agents/skills/`
- Dispatch template: `docs/autoclaw/templates/agent-dispatch.md`

## Hard Rules
- Binary rating ONLY (Again/Good), no Hard/Easy
- NEVER `process.env` in Edge → use `context.env.*`
- No Prisma in frontend code
- `safePrismaDisconnect` in every Edge finally block
- `trash` > `rm`

## Verification Ladder
```
npm run typecheck:ci && npm run build && npm run test:critical && npm run build:check-size
```
